_comment: Which playlist plays on which dates. Rules are checked top to bottom;
the first match wins. Dates are MM-DD, inclusive, and may wrap past
New Year (e.g. from 12-20 to 01-02). Outside every window, 'default'
plays. 'tvctl set NAME' overrides all of this until 'tvctl auto'.
Optional per rule: mix_in + mix_ratio sprinkle episodes from another
playlist into the holiday rotation so 30 Treehouse episodes don't get
stale over a whole month. mix_ratio 0.25 = roughly one in four picks.
